dialogues.title: The Unlit Road
dialogues.speaker: mara
dialogues.text: Mind the road after dusk. Half our lanterns are dark, and the last wagon came in without its driver.

choices.text: Can I help with the lanterns?
I have all the coal you asked for.
How is the road looking now?

dialogues.title: Fuel for the Watch
dialogues.speaker: mara
dialogues.text: Bring me eight pieces of coal. With fresh fuel, we can keep the watch posts lit. I'll give you two emeralds and see that your work is remembered.

choices.text: Eight coal. I'll bring them back here.
I can't take that on right now.

dialogues.title: A Light to Follow
dialogues.speaker: mara
dialogues.text: Thank you. Bring the coal to me at the watch post. Don't hand it over to the wagon crews; their stoves will swallow it before nightfall.

choices.text: I'll return when I have it.

dialogues.title: Still Waiting on Fuel
dialogues.speaker: mara
dialogues.text: Eight pieces of coal, all together. Once you have them, bring them here and I'll get the lantern crews moving.

dialogues.title: Light the Watch Posts
dialogues.speaker: mara
dialogues.text: That's enough to get us through tonight. Shall I take the coal and pay you?

dialogues.title: The Road Burns Bright
dialogues.speaker: mara
dialogues.text: Every post is burning bright. Here's your pay. Next time you see those lights from the road, remember that you helped put them there.

quests.title: Lanterns for the Road
quests.logText: Bring eight pieces of coal to Mara at the watch post. The lantern crews need fuel before dusk.
quests.completeText: Mara has fuel for the watch posts. The road will be safer tonight.

objectives.description: Collect eight pieces of coal and hand them to Mara.
